events.verdict: Brogdon (MIL) maintains his left pivot after the gather in the lane.

RHH shows Brogdon (MIL) initiates marginal contact with Lamb (CHA) that does not affect his ability to defend.
DiVincenzo (MIL) makes contact with Walker (CHA)'s body and affects his driving shot attempt.
Connaughton (MIL) is in the path of Walker (CHA) and does not deliver any contact on his pick.
Middleton (MIL) makes body contact with Kidd-Gilchrist (CHA) before he steps out of bounds that dislodges him from his legally obtained position and ability to control the ball.
Parker (CHA) makes high-five contact with Connaughton (MIL)'s hand after he has released the ball.
Bledsoe (MIL) cleanly deflects the pass from Walker (CHA).
Kidd-Gilchrist (CHA) makes marginal body contact with Bledsoe (MIL) and does not affect his ability to pass.
Walker (CHA) makes marginal contact with the arm of Connaughton (MIL) after his rebound but he easily plays through the contact and maintains control of the ball.

Kidd-Gilchrist (CHA) makes high-five contact with Middleton (MIL)'s hand after he has released the ball.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) cleanly dislodges the ball from Parker (CHA).
Kidd-Gilchrist (CHA) maintains a legal guarding position on the drive by Antetokounmpo (MIL).
Williams (CHA) maintains a legal guarding position on Antetokounmpo (MIL)'s shot.
Kidd-Gilchrist (CHA) makes marginal contact with Antetokounmpo (MIL) that does not affect his movement to the rebound.
As Antetokounmpo (MIL) gathers the rebound and on the way down the ball is cleanly dislodged by Walker (CHA).
Antetokounmpo (MIL) commits a take foul on Walker (CHA).
Lopez (MIL) is in the path of Kidd-Gilchrist (CHA) when he absorbs the contact on the screen.
Batum (CHA) slightly grasps the jersey of Lopez (MIL) on the inbound but does not affect his FOM.
